description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides functions to interact with a backend API for managing and retrieving chess game history, hints, and analysis. It includes utilities for building URLs, performing safe fetch requests, and exporting API functions for listing history, fetching specific games, getting hints, and analysis results.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for API requests based on the base URL and provided path.

methods.name: safeFetch(url, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request that gracefully handles network errors and no-backend mode.

methods.name: listHistory({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, result = 'all' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of game history, returning demo data in no-backend mode.

methods.name: getGameById(gameId)
methods.description: Fetches a specific game by its ID, returning demo data if no backend response.

methods.name: getHintForPosition({ gameId, plyIndex })
methods.description: Provides a move hint for a given game position; returns demo suggestions if no backend.

methods.name: getAnalysisForGame(gameId)
methods.description: Retrieves post-game analysis data, with demo info in no-backend mode.

ctags.name: listHistory
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listHistory({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, result = 'all' } = {}) {$/
